name: Focalboard
tagline: Open source alternative to Trello, Notion, and Asana. From Mattermost.
shortDescription: Focalboard is an open source project tracking tool from the Mattermost team. Boards, cards, properties, views (Kanban, Table, Calendar, Gallery). Self-host or use the free cloud.
longDescription:
## What it is

Focalboard is an open source project tracking tool from the Mattermost team. Boards with cards, custom properties, multiple views (Kanban, Table, Calendar, Gallery), templates, and personal/team boards.

## Why we recommend it

If you want the Trello/Notion/Asana experience without the SaaS fees, Focalboard is the cleanest open source option. It's actively developed by the Mattermost team and integrates with Mattermost.

## When to use it

- Self-hosted Trello/Asana replacement
- Personal + team boards
- Integration with Mattermost
- Project tracking for small teams
installInstructions:
**Docker:**
```
docker run -d --name focalboard -p 8000:8000 mattermost/focalboard:latest
```

**Personal desktop:** Download from focalboard.com (Mac, Windows, Linux).
pricingDetails: Free. MIT licensed. Self-host or use Personal Desktop (free).
